description: Main application source code for a Bluetooth Mesh device using Zephyr RTOS, implementing OnOff server and client models, provisioning, and Bluetooth initialization.

methods.name: attention_on
methods.description: Callback to turn on the LED when attention is needed.

methods.name: attention_off
methods.description: Callback to turn off the LED when attention is no longer needed.

methods.name: model_time_decode
methods.description: Decodes transition time from a byte value to milliseconds.

methods.name: model_time_encode
methods.description: Encodes transition time in milliseconds to a byte value.

methods.name: onoff_status_send
methods.description: Sends the current OnOff status over Bluetooth Mesh.

methods.name: onoff_timeout
methods.description: Handles transition timeout for OnOff state changes.

methods.name: gen_onoff_get
methods.description: Handles get requests for OnOff state.

methods.name: gen_onoff_set_unack
methods.description: Handles unacknowledged set requests for OnOff state.

methods.name: gen_onoff_set
methods.description: Handles acknowledged set requests for OnOff state.

methods.name: gen_onoff_status
methods.description: Handles status messages for OnOff client.

methods.name: button_pressed
methods.description: Handles button press event to toggle OnOff state or perform provisioning.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Callback after Bluetooth is initialized, sets up Mesh.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes hardware, Bluetooth, and Mesh.
